quotes.text: This is the Unix philosophy: Write programs that do one thing and do it well. Write programs to work together. Write programs to handle text streams, because that is a universal interface.
quotes.author: Doug McIlroy

quotes.text: When in doubt, use brute force.
quotes.author: Ken Thompson

quotes.text: Windows is great at the NT kernel — performance, drivers, security model — but Win32 and the UI layer above it is just mediocre. Linux is great at the tools — 'everything is a file', composable command-line programs. Therefore the reverse of this project might be the best outcome.
quotes.author: londons_explore
quotes.source: Hacker News — Win4wine – Run Windows Shell as the Linux Desktop on Wine
quotes.extraction_note: Sharp layered take: keep the good bottom of each stack, throw away the mediocre top. Slightly spicy because it implies both platforms are half-built.

quotes.author: bryanlarsen
quotes.source: Hacker News — What's the difference between an integer and a pointer? (2018)
quotes.extraction_note: Dense one-liner that captures a genuinely subtle CS distinction — perfect length, instantly memorable.

quotes.text: macOS, like Windows and unlike Linux, doesn't have a stable syscall interface. Apps are instead required to dynamically link with libraries shipped with your system, which change in lockstep with the syscalls.
quotes.author: miki123211
quotes.source: Hacker News — XNU Linux: Full OS X GUI Userspace on Linux
quotes.extraction_note: Clean, factual insight that quietly indicts the 'walled garden' design — a good reminder that Linux's stable syscall ABI is a gift, not a given.

quotes.text: Makes me wonder if the next frontier is going to be something like "the OS is shipped encrypted with keys that only exist in hardware, and all the CPU knows how to do is decrypt blocks and put them in the i-cache where it will not let you look at them" — to prevent you from doing anything with the OS executables other than running them.
quotes.author: pcwalton
quotes.source: Hacker News — XNU Linux: Full OS X GUI Userspace on Linux
quotes.extraction_note: Darkly funny extrapolation of where vendor lock-in is heading — vivid imagery and genuinely unsettling once you think about it.
